facts.name: Timothy J. Koenig
facts.assignment: Chief/Circuit Judge, Key West. Profile states general circuit civil, probate/guardianship, some foreclosure/family, felony and involuntary civil commitment matters; also describes appellate/writ duties. Source description retained, not an independent jurisdiction determination.

contact.contact_note: Published office phone shared with named assistant; no separately published personal judge email or assistant-only line. Probate case-manager contact is separate from judicial assistant.

scheduling.summary: Coordinate all counsel’s availability and request motion hearings by JA email; email notice to confirm docket setting. Obtain court approval before setting a case-management conference.

communications.summary: JA communications limited to scheduling and agreed/pronounced orders; copy all parties/counsel and avoid substantive ex parte messages.

proposed_orders.summary: Use Florida eFiling Portal with separate PDF cover letter and referenced exhibits. Linked May18,2023 memo preserves DJMCA formatting placeholders and font rules; consult memo for exact formatting and judge-dependent service certificate.

courtesy_copies.summary: Provide documents to be considered before the hearing. No general civil numerical lead time or delivery channel stated in this profile paragraph.

remote_appearance.summary: Linked Zoom guide: join five minutes early, use identifying names and audio/video for testimony; court supplies meeting ID through counsel. Arrange your court reporter; no Zoom recording. Guide is not blanket permission for every matter to appear remotely.

noncivil_basic_operations.summary: Probate hearings through JA and Portal orders; family final dissolution hearings specially set through JA. Criminal motions through JA; specialized criminal scheduling details not analyzed.

review_scope.collected: Profile original HTML, expanded DOM/text with timestamps, roster, Zoom PDF, scanned3page proposed-order memo with renders/manual excerpts.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contact/assignment and recurring office requirements; memo submission/format and Zoom participation paragraphs.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Criminal pretrial/VOP specifics, foreclosureAO2.072 litigation details, Zoom exhibit/admission rules, specimen order substance, personal biography.

gaps: No separate personal judge email, assistant-only phone or chambers room established.
Profile appellate-role description retained as stated; assignment-order reconciliation remains county-level work.
